items.title: H-observation-interface positive demonstration: does a foraging-adequate re-representation lift D3 competence? (conversion_ceiling_root, diagnostic)
items.note: GOV-FANOUT-1 representation-axis probe supplying the positive demonstration the H-observation-interface leg of conversion_ceiling_root names as its own registry gate ('Needs a positive demonstration -- a foraging-adequate re-representation lifts competence -- to confirm'). Successor to V3-EXQ-813, which ELEVATED the leg but could only establish it negatively. DIAGNOSTIC: claim_ids=[], promotes and demotes nothing; route to /failure-autopsy before any governance use. | DESIGN: four arms hold the learner (PPO) and objective (W3_survival_zeroed, imported verbatim from V3-EXQ-808) FIXED and vary ONLY the observation vector -- ppo_ree_latent (z_world, 32d; 813 floor anchor 0.5), ppo_raw_obs (373d; 813 ceiling anchor 9.033), ppo_latent_plus_localfield (z_world + resource_field_view, 57d; THE positive demonstration), ppo_localfield_only (25d; interference discriminator that separates passive under-exposure from the latent actively obstructing). The added channel is not invented: the local_view_greedy anchor scores ~45.75 res/ep reading ONLY resource_field_view, so its adequacy under the learner's own observability is certified inside this same run, and it is a subset of world_state which the 9.033 arm already sees. Dimensionality is near-matched (32 vs 25) so a lift cannot be attributed to a wider input. | GOV-REUSE-1 (step 2.4): decisive readout is D3 foraging_competence for the two re-representation arms. Checked every manifest carrying the conversion_ceiling_root hypothesis_space tag -- only v3_exq_808_...20260724T044039Z and v3_exq_813_...20260724T143333Z exist, and neither runs a latent+field or field-only arm. Not recoverable by reanalysis -> run. | RE-DERIVE BRAKE (step 2.5b): not braked. claim_ids=[] and this is a diagnostic discriminating WHY the ceiling holds, which the brake explicitly exempts; matches the brake_exempt stance V3-EXQ-808 and V3-EXQ-813 carry for this same fanout lineage. (MECH-457 counts 13 and ARC-065 counts 11, but this run tags neither.) | KNOWN LIMITATION (step 2.5c, user-adjudicated release to degrading): two open corrupting substrate_queue entries overlap the driver's import closure -- mode-governance-engagement (agent.py, utils/config.py, salience_coordinator.py) and contextmemory-write-path-addressing-degeneracy (predictors/e1_deep.py). Both are implemented_pending_validation with repairs behind default-off flags (ree-v3 9bcde4c, 692f852), so the default config path still executes the un-repaired code. Released because the design is internally controlled: both defects are present IDENTICALLY in arms 1 and 3, the pair carrying the decisive contrast, and absent from arms 2 and 4 which instantiate no REE agent -- so neither can manufacture or mask the arm-3-minus-arm-1 lift. MECH122-CONTENT-PACKAGING-SPINDLE-SELECTION scoped out (its ::function entries are sleep-path; this driver runs no sleep). | DV-SYMMETRY (per arm): DV is D3 foraging_competence, a count of resources consumed per eval episode. Every arm's manipulation changes the OBSERVATION VECTOR the PPO policy conditions on, hence the action distribution, hence the trajectory, hence the count. No arm's manipulation is a broadcast additive constant over candidate scores (no candidate-score layer exists -- PPO emits logits over 5 primitive actions directly from the observation), a monotone rescaling of a rank-valued DV, or a permutation of interchangeable units. So no arm's delta is an arithmetic identity fixed before the run; arms 1 and 2 replicate 813 cells that empirically DID move this DV (0.5 vs 9.033). | PRECONDITION FIX: V3-EXQ-813's per-arm consumption_share gate (floor 0.90) is deliberately NOT reproduced -- it is CIRCULAR. At w_survival=0.0 survival-linked families are zeroed by construction (survival_linked_share reads exactly 0.0 on all 6 of 813's cells), so the entire residual is harm, which accrues per-tick from the env while consumption accrues only when an arm forages; the share therefore falls when an arm forages less and penalised each arm for the failure under test (0.5717 latent at 0.5 res/ep vs 0.8097 raw-obs at 9.033). It forced the whole-run substrate_not_ready_requeue self-route that the confirmed 813 autopsy had to override by user judgment. Replaced by survival_linked_share_zeroed (structural, direction upper, <=1e-9) and harm_share_negligible_on_control (measured on the local_view_greedy POSITIVE CONTROL, not on an arm under test). | Smoke PASS (--dry-run, 2026-08-25): all four arms constructed and trained at obs_dim 32/373/57/25 as designed, structural-vacuity audit clean over 20 (spec, arm) pairs, all gates green, non_degenerate=true, z_goal_stream active_frac=0.325 with no writer defect. validate_experiments --strict OK on all 30 checks.
